completed.summary: Autonomous assurance foundation: Gate 0 provenance, fail-closed assurance schema, deterministic A1 auditor, tests and docs.
No-regression ratchet for measured deterministic A1 defect classes.
Unit 1 repaired to zero deterministic findings, controlled GB/US example audio regenerated, version-bound artifacts refreshed, and strict Unit 1 assurance locked into validate:data.
Versioned four-role semantic judge schemas, fail-closed arbitration, hash/version evidence binding, semantic evidence consistency check and tests.
Curriculum-aware semantic packets, four versioned role prompts, opt-in isolated OpenAI-compatible/local runner, evidence merge command, and packet freshness CI.
Fail-closed external evidence ingestion, stale hash/version rejection, cross-role isolation checks, endpoint preflight, compatibility switch, and tests.
Manual-only semantic judge execution workflow, role-scoped preflight, automatic-trigger/write-permission safety gate, and recorded endpoint-resolution contract.
Verified four-provider zero-cost judge allocation, machine-readable presets, automatic workflow defaults, and CI enforcement of zero-cost-only distinct provider/model policy.
Re-ranked free judges by role fit; upgraded Persian to Gemini 3.8 Flash, pedagogy to MiniMax M2.7 Free, adversarial to Qwen 3.8 27B; retained GPT-OSS 120B for English.
Frozen 28-case Vajefy semantic calibration, pre-registered promotion thresholds, repeated-run stability checks, qualification ledger, and Unit 1 qualification gate.
One-dispatch-per-role calibration automation: three repeats, strict scoring, qualification recording, allowlisted commit, and retained raw evidence.
Automatic main-push exact-revision wait plus GitHub OIDC authenticated GET-only semantic gateway contract smoke; no inference.
Fail-closed Workers AI Neuron budget: 84 frozen calibration requests bounded at 7,788 Neurons, current-rate freshness gate, lower-Neuron Qwen3 adversarial candidate, and runtime budget preflight.
docs/A1_PLAN_STATUS.md status ledger in the plan §31 state model, checked by npm run status:check in validate:data and in CI with full history; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md point every session at it.
Every deterministic finding code ratcheted (unknown codes at zero, fixes must be recorded); Unicode/bidi/NFC and Persian-in-English checks; course-wide curriculum frontier for entry and scene tasks.
EXAMPLE_NEAR_DUPLICATE and EXAMPLE_REUSED ratcheted; Practice reduced to Smart Practice, Listening and Spelling; deprecated modes, components and copy removed; XP off Progress.
Service worker installs only A1 course data; docs/FEATURES.md with features:check in CI.
Per-sense fail-closed Machine Assurance Records bound to semantic input hashes; generation provenance for every A1 entry. First implementation package (plan §41) complete except Gate 0 rights.
Audio flags separate notation differences from real pronunciation mismatches: 292 flags became 174.
Scheduled free-allocation calibration and qualification: candidate registry, planner, write-ahead Neuron reservations, rates refresh. Post-merge CI and gateway smoke (run 37545667281) passed.

Standalone NGSL selection, draft checking and review exports authenticate pinned core/licence Git blobs and canonical selection. Independent staging now has 360/900 unapproved bilingual drafts; full CI and rollback passed.

140 contextual Persian supports across 133 tasks lowered task/scene frontier counts to 4966/59 and the complete corpus to 9994 findings. Frozen Units 1–3 and audio/curriculum stayed unchanged; full CI and rollback passed.

853 reference notes linked from 417 actual A1 plan entries, exact word links, course-only Review enrolment/due/data loading, saved mixed-session preservation and offline index. Full 535-unit/95-browser CI and rollback passed.

Four later-unit Persian-in-English repairs, six literal mistake translations and one Persian grammar explanation reduced deterministic findings from 9994 to 9983. Frozen source entries and audio/curriculum/scene sources are unchanged. Integrated scheduled calibration evidence; full CI 38043997584 (535 units, 95 browser tests), Workers contract and rollback 38043997585 passed.
